PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JANUARY 9, 2020
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French, Henderson, and Smith
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of December 12, 2019
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. Conditional Use Permit 09-07 Time Extension No. 1
American Tower Corporation, Applicant
A request for a 10-year time extension to Conditional Use Permit 09-07 for the operation of an existing Major Wireless Telecommunications Facility located at 39800 Country Club Drive (Antelope Valley Country Club).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-002 approving CUP 09-07 Time Extension No. 1 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 09-12 Time Extension No. 1
American Tower Corporation, Applicant
A request for a 10-year time extension to Conditional Use Permit 09-12 for the operation of an existing Major Wireless Telecommunications Facility located at 1 Hauser Mountain.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-001 approving CUP 09-12 Time Extension No. 1, and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from CEQA review. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
8B
8C. Conditional Use Permit 09-17 Time Extension No. 1
American Tower Corporation, Applicant
A request for a 10-year time extension to Conditional Use Permit 09-17 for the operation of an existing Major Wireless Telecommunications Facility located at 39331 10th Street West.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-003 approving Conditional Use Permit 09-17 Time Extension No. 1 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
8C
